name: Sagimiya Kaguya
source: The older sister of the Protagonist. She is a university student and has a strong and cool character. She helps the Protagonist to control his passion. While she is the oldest daughter of Hazuki, she has a different father than the Protagonist and Misaki. [spoiler]Taka was and is her father.[/spoiler]
